description: Built at Toulouse in 1956, Werknummer 128; preserved behind the former LTG 61 command building on the closed Landsberg/Penzing air base and looked after by the Traditionsgemeinschaft Lufttransport LTG 61, which washes, seals and protects it. It wears the LTG 61 chamois badge. The airfield lost its military status in August 2020 and the aircraft's long-term future is unsettled; the Luftlandeschule at Altenstadt and Oberschleissheim have both expressed interest in it. Access only by arrangement with the association.
